items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think of the night that I really liked Dick Nixon, who I hadn’t been a fan of.

ctx.x: I see. What’s the protocol for that? Do you play a whole set? Do you play just one or two numbers?

You play maybe three or four. The Ellington night, there’s so many jazz musicians that you just go up and play one tune. When I think of the Ellington night, I think of the night that I really liked Dick Nixon, who I hadn’t been a fan of. But he said – we’re at the dinner in a separate room. He gets up to make a speech of welcome.
